definitions.gloss: half in fun; half-heartedly; not seriously
definitions.explanation: Doing something partly as play, without real seriousness. Usually critical: something that deserves effort or care is being done casually, or something dangerous is being treated as a game.

examples.japanese: {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧な。
examples.english: Don't do it half in fun.

examples.japanese: {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: Climbing a mountain in a half-playful frame of mind is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{始|はじ}めた⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I took up the guitar half for fun at first, but now I am aiming to go pro.

notes:
⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (play) + ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧ (half). Used adverbially with で: {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}で〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}で〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do ~ half in fun
- {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧: a not-serious attitude
- {遊|あそ}び{半分|はんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: it cannot be done half-heartedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冗談半分|じょうだんはんぶん}: half joking (of what one says)
- ⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧: seriousness; the opposite attitude
